subject.title: feat: discover OpenCode and Pi sessions on paired nodes

question: Should paired-node OpenCode and Pi catalogs be enabled by default and allowed to turn read-scoped catalog requests into trusted-plugin `operator.write` node invocations?
rationale: The choice determines both the user-consent model for exposing local transcripts and the authority granted to bundled plugins; tests can prove mechanics but cannot establish the intended security and upgrade policy.

options.title: Preserve explicit consent
options.body: Require node-local catalog opt-in and introduce a narrowly scoped internal invocation path rather than granting general synthetic write scope.

options.title: Approve trusted default-on behavior
options.body: Keep default discovery and scope synthesis, but document the trust model and add focused tests proving only registered trusted commands can use the elevated path.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit consent
recommendation.body: Require node-local catalog opt-in and introduce a narrowly scoped internal invocation path rather than granting general synthetic write scope.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature proposal and six-commit implementation span both the consent defaults and Gateway scope behavior.
